newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases on selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases on selling pressure.

text.p: Strong selling pressure pushed the Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-index 3.31 points down to 3388.79, brokers said.
They said turnover was posted at 39.461 million shillings on 2,395,661 shares from 34.873 million shillings on Wednesday.
They said the day's trading was dull as many investors were reluctant to release their shares -- trading with dividend, despite the heavy selling pressure in the market.
"The index would have fallen further were it not for a big lot of Kenya Airways traded between foreigners," a broker said.

Kenya Airways traded 1,984,752 shares at between 8.60 and 9.0 shillings compared to Wednesday's close of 8.50. This boosted turnover and cushioned the index's drop. Brokers said other prices across boards seesawed within narrow ranges.
Kenya Commercial Bank eased to 95 from 96, while Kenya Power Lighting shed three shillings to 115.
Uchumi Supermarket was unchanged at 36 while Rea Vipingo eased to 9.65 from 9.85.
"There is not much activity in the market which is a seasonal occurrence ahead of the Easter holidays', a bourse official said.
Standard Chartered Bank edged to 47 from 46.75 while Barclays Bank was unchanged at 112.
Lonrho Motors closed at 200 from 189 while Unga Group was firm at 112 from 111.
